correctness.rationale: The row-and-column weights in RESULT.md are pairwise distinct, so the projective fixed locus consists exactly of the coordinate lines lying in the variety. For E_ij every northwest rank is 0 except those in the southeast quadrant of (i,j), where it is 1. Monotonicity of the rank bounds makes membership equivalent to r_w(i,j)>0, or i>=m_j. The complex-algebraic torus identity for compactly supported Euler characteristic applies without a smoothness assumption; projectivity identifies this with ordinary topological Euler characteristic. The j-th summand ranges from j to n: equality in all lower bounds forces the first j values to be the j largest for each j, and equality in all upper bounds is equivalent to w(1)=1. This includes n=1 and gives 9 for 132, whose only nonautomatic condition is the northwest 2-by-2 determinant. The frozen artifacts/verify.py checks membership and the extremal statements for n<=7, not the torus identity. The decision rests on the all-n proof, not on executing the uploaded script.
